def fn(x):
    # QWERTY order for the 26 letters
    qwerty = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    normal = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

    # build lower‑case mapping
    lower_map = {normal[i]: qwerty[i] for i in range(26)}
    # build upper‑case mapping
    upper_map = {normal[i].upper(): qwerty[i].upper() for i in range(26)}

    # translate the string
    res = []
    for ch in x:
        if ch.islower():
            res.append(lower_map.get(ch, ch))
        elif ch.isupper():
            res.append(upper_map.get(ch, ch))
        else:
            res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)
